symptoms.ingress_unreachable: The Ingress does not deliver traffic to its backend.

facts.ingress_backend_missing: Ingress {ingress} routes to Service {service}, which does not exist.
facts.ingress_backend_endpoints: Ingress {ingress} routes to Service {service}, which has no ready endpoints.
facts.ingress_backend_port_missing: Ingress {ingress} sends traffic to port {port} of Service {service}, but the Service does not declare it.
facts.ingress_class_missing: Ingress {ingress} names IngressClass {class}, which does not exist.
facts.ingress_class_unspecified: Ingress {ingress} names no IngressClass, and the cluster has no default IngressClass.
facts.ingress_resource_backend: Ingress {ingress} routes to a {kind} named {name}; Kubron does not inspect backends of this kind.

hypotheses.ingress_backend_service_missing: Service {service}, the backend of Ingress {ingress}, does not exist, so the controller has nowhere to send requests.
hypotheses.ingress_backend_no_endpoints: Service {service}, the backend of Ingress {ingress}, has no ready endpoints, so requests get no answer.
hypotheses.ingress_backend_port_mismatch: Ingress {ingress} uses port {port} of Service {service}, which the Service does not declare.
hypotheses.ingress_class_not_found: No ingress controller may serve Ingress {ingress}: its IngressClass is missing or not set.

recommendations.rec_create_backend_service: Create Service {service} or point Ingress {ingress} to an existing Service.
recommendations.rec_fix_ingress_class: Set an existing IngressClass instead of {class} in Ingress {ingress}, or create that class.
recommendations.rec_set_ingress_class: Set spec.ingressClassName in Ingress {ingress}, or mark one IngressClass as the default.
recommendations.rec_fix_ingress_backend_port: Use a port that Service {service} declares (by name or number) instead of {port} in Ingress {ingress}.

steps.step_check_tls_secret: Check that Secret {secret} used by Ingress {ingress} exists, holds a valid certificate and key, and is in the same namespace. Kubron does not read Secrets.

graphReasons.ingress_backend_port_missing: Backend port is not declared by the Service
